hints.select: Arrow Up / W and Arrow Down / S select the previous or next visible row.
hints.expand: Arrow Right / D opens the selected branch or selects its first child.
hints.back: Arrow Left / A collapses the selected branch or selects its parent.
hints.open: Press Enter or hold a row for the chosen duration to open its documents or HXDoc. A short click only expands or collapses it.
hints.context: Press E to open the selected information. Keep holding E for the chosen duration to open it in Picture-in-Picture.
hints.close: Q or Escape closes information and returns focus to its row. The Picture-in-Picture window stays open.
hints.navigation: Z goes back and X goes forward in site history. C refreshes the current material, V switches its view, and B cycles the link mode.
hints.journal: H opens history, N opens bookmarks, and F or M opens search. Hold Search to open query history. In bookmarks, V switches list and tree.
hints.bookmarks: < and > open the previous and next bookmark. / opens the last opened or created bookmark. Shift+/ removes the bookmark matching the bottom address.

appearance.contextOpen: Hold E for the chosen duration to open the current information in Picture-in-Picture.
